bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
unit=gace-userbot-verify.service
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet "$unit" || exit 91
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit" || exit 92
test -f /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session || exit 93
systemctl --user restart "$unit"
sleep 9
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit" || exit 94
journalctl --user -u "$unit" --since '2 minutes ago' --no-pager -o cat | grep -q USERBOT_SESSION_CONNECTED || exit 95
test "$(stat -c %a /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session)" = 600 || exit 96
linger=$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
if test "$linger" != yes; then
 if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then sudo -n loginctl enable-linger "$(id -un)"; fi
 linger=$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
fi
echo USERBOT_RESTART_REUSE=PASS
echo USERBOT_UNIT_ACTIVE=YES
echo USERBOT_UNIT_ENABLED=YES
echo USER_LINGER="$linger"
echo PHONE_LOGIN_REPEATED=NO
